  • Methodendetails

    • debug

      public void debug(@NonNull String message, Object... args)
      Beschreibung aus Schnittstelle kopiert: LogAdapter

      Delegating logger implementation that forwards log calls to configurable consumers.

      This implementation enables flexible integration with any logging framework by accepting BiConsumers for each log level. Each consumer receives the message and arguments array, allowing framework-specific formatting and handling.

      Instances should be created via LogAdapter.delegatingLogAdapter(BiConsumer, BiConsumer, BiConsumer, BiConsumer).

      Angegeben von:
      debug in Schnittstelle LogAdapter

    • debug

      public void debug(@NonNull String message)
      Beschreibung aus Schnittstelle kopiert: LogAdapter

      Logs a debug-level message.

      Debug messages provide detailed diagnostic information useful during development and troubleshooting. They typically include fine-grained state information and should not be enabled in production environments due to their verbosity.

      Angegeben von:
      debug in Schnittstelle LogAdapter
      Parameter:
      message - the log message; must not be null

    • info

      public void info(@NonNull String message, @NonNull Object... args)
      Beschreibung aus Schnittstelle kopiert: LogAdapter

      Logs an info-level message with optional arguments.

      Info messages highlight the progress of the application at a coarse-grained level. They provide general informational messages about normal system operation and significant events or state changes.

      Angegeben von:
      info in Schnittstelle LogAdapter
      Parameter:
      message - the log message; must not be null
      args - optional arguments; interpretation depends on the logging framework

      public void warn(@NonNull String message, @NonNull Object... args)
      Beschreibung aus Schnittstelle kopiert: LogAdapter

      Logs a warning-level message with optional arguments.

      Warning messages indicate potentially harmful situations or unexpected behavior that does not prevent the system from functioning. They signal conditions that should be reviewed but do not require immediate action. Examples include deprecated API usage, suboptimal configuration, or recoverable errors.

      Angegeben von:
      warn in Schnittstelle LogAdapter
      Parameter:
      message - the log message; must not be null
      args - optional arguments; interpretation depends on the logging framework

    • error

      public void error(@NonNull String message, @NonNull Object... args)
      Beschreibung aus Schnittstelle kopiert: LogAdapter

      Logs an error-level message with optional arguments.

      Error messages indicate serious problems that prevented an operation from completing successfully. They represent failures that require attention but typically allow the system to continue running. If the last argument is a Throwable, it should be logged with its stack trace.

      Angegeben von:
      error in Schnittstelle LogAdapter
      Parameter:
      message - the log message; must not be null
      args - optional arguments; interpretation depends on the logging framework; the last argument may be a Throwable for exception logging
